name: Flux.2 Klein (upscale)
description: Upscale an image with Flux.2 Klein: the image is scaled up, then the tail of the model's own sampling schedule is re-run so it puts detail into what the scaler could only interpolate. Flux.2 shifts its schedule by resolution, so the scheduler is told the size the scaler produced.

params.label: Creativity
params.description: How much of the model's schedule to re-run, and so how far it may stray from the original. 0.2 sharpens; higher redraws, and starts inventing detail that was never there.

params.label: Scale
params.description: How many times larger than the source.

params.label: Prompt
params.description: What the picture is. Leave it empty to let the image speak for itself.

params.label: Use an upscale model
params.description: Scale with a trained upscale model (ESRGAN and friends) instead of a pixel filter. It hands the sampler real edges to work from rather than a blur, so less of the result is invented.

params.label: Upscale model
params.description: Which upscale model to scale with. Pick one before turning "Use an upscale model" on; it needs a file in `upscale_models/`.

params.label: Model scale
params.description: An upscale model scales by the factor it was trained at, usually 4×. This brings that back to the Scale you asked for: 0.5 turns a 4× model into a 2× upscale.

params.label: Steps
params.description: The model's full schedule, of which Creativity re-runs the tail. Raise it to give a low creativity more real steps to work in.
